name: Common Cold
description: A common viral infection of the nose and throat.

name: Influenza (Flu)
description: A viral infection that attacks your respiratory system.

name: Migraine
description: A headache of varying intensity, often accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light and sound.
treatments: Rest in a dark room;Stress management;Hydration

name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)
symptoms: Dry skin;Itching;Red to brownish-gray patches;Small, raised bumps
description: A condition that makes your skin red and itchy.
treatments: Moisturize regularly;Avoid harsh soaps;Apply medicated creams

name: Asthma
symptoms: Shortness of breath;Chest tightness or pain;Wheezing;Coughing attacks
description: A condition in which your airways narrow and swell and may produce extra mucus.

name: Diabetes Type 2
description: A chronic condition that affects the way the body processes blood sugar (glucose).

name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
description: A common condition in which the long-term force of the blood against your artery walls is high enough that it may eventually cause health problems.
treatments: Healthy diet with less salt;Regular physical activity;Maintain a healthy weight

name: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
symptoms: Burning sensation in your chest (heartburn);Chest pain;Difficulty swallowing;Regurgitation of food or sour liquid
description: A chronic digestive disease. GERD occurs when stomach acid or, occasionally, stomach content, flows back into your food pipe (esophagus).
treatments: lose weight;Avoid foods that trigger heartburn;Eat smaller meals

name: Pneumonia
symptoms: Chest pain when you breathe or cough;Confusion or changes in mental awareness;Cough which may produce phlegm;Fatigue;Fever, sweating and shaking chills
description: An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs. The air sacs may fill with fluid or pus.

name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
symptoms: Strong, persistent urge to urinate;Burning sensation when urinating;Passing frequent, small amounts of urine;Urine that appears cloudy
description: An infection in any part of your urinary system — your kidneys, ureters, bladder and urethra.

name: Acne
description: A skin condition that occurs when your hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells.

name: Allergies
symptoms: Sneezing;Itching of the nose, eyes or roof of the mouth;Runny, stuffy nose;Watery, red or swollen eyes (conjunctivitis)
description: A condition in which the immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

name: Anemia
symptoms: Fatigue;Weakness;Pale or yellowish skin;Irregular heartbeats;Shortness of breath
description: A condition in which you lack enough healthy red blood cells to carry adequate oxygen to your body's tissues.
medications: Iron ferrous sulfate;Vitamin B-12 supplements;Folic acid supplements

name: Arthritis
description: Inflammation of one or more of your joints.

name: Bronchitis
symptoms: Cough;Production of mucus (sputum), which can be clear, white, yellowish-gray or green in color;Fatigue;Shortness of breath
description: Inflammation of the lining of your bronchial tubes, which carry air to and from your lungs.

name: Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye)
symptoms: Redness in the inner eyelid and white of the eye;Itchiness;Gritty feeling;Discharge that forms a crust
description: Inflammation or infection of the transparent membrane (conjunctiva) that lines your eyelid and covers the white part of your eyeball.
medications: Antibiotic eye drops;Antihistamine eye drops;Artificial tears

name: Depression
symptoms: Feelings of sadness, tearfulness, emptiness or hopelessness;Angry outbursts;Loss of interest or pleasure in most or all normal activities
description: A mood disorder that causes a persistent feeling of sadness and loss of interest.

name: Gastritis
symptoms: Gnawing or burning ache or pain (indigestion) in your upper abdomen that may become either worse or better with eating;Nausea;Vomiting
description: Inflammation of the protective lining of the stomach.

name: Chickenpox
description: A highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy, blister-like rash on the skin.

name: Malaria
symptoms: Fever;Chills;General feeling of discomfort;Headache;Nausea and vomiting;Diarrhea;Abdominal pain;Muscle or joint pain
description: A disease caused by a plasmodium parasite, transmitted by the bite of infected mosquitoes.

name: Tuberculosis
description: A serious infectious disease that mainly affects the lungs.

name: Dengue Fever
symptoms: High fever;Severe headache;Pain behind eyes;Joint and muscle pain;Rash
description: A mosquito-borne viral infection causing flu-like illness.

name: Typhoid
symptoms: Sustained fever;Weakness;Stomach pain;Constipation or diarrhea;Loss of appetite
description: A bacterial infection spread through contaminated food and water.

name: Hepatitis A
description: A viral liver disease spread through contaminated food or water.

name: Hepatitis B
description: A serious liver infection caused by hepatitis B virus.

name: Hepatitis C
description: A blood-borne viral infection that causes liver inflammation.

name: COVID-19
symptoms: Fever;Dry cough;Loss of taste or smell;Fatigue;Breathing difficulty
description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by coronavirus.

name: Cholera
description: An acute diarrheal disease caused by contaminated water.

name: Appendicitis
description: Inflammation of the appendix requiring urgent treatment.

name: Epilepsy
description: A neurological disorder marked by recurrent seizures.

name: Parkinson’s Disease
description: A progressive nervous system disorder affecting movement.

name: Alzheimer’s Disease
description: A progressive disease that destroys memory and thinking skills.

name: Osteoporosis
description: A condition that weakens bones, making them fragile.

name: Gout
description: A form of arthritis caused by uric acid buildup.

name: Thyroid Hypothyroidism
description: A condition where thyroid produces insufficient hormones.

name: Polio
description: A viral disease that can affect nerves and lead to paralysis.

name: Leprosy
description: A chronic infectious disease affecting skin and nerves.

name: Mumps
description: A viral infection affecting salivary glands.

name: Rabies
description: A fatal viral disease transmitted through animal bites.

name: Anxiety Disorder
description: A mental health condition characterized by excessive fear or anxiety.

name: Insomnia
description: A sleep disorder that makes it hard to fall or stay asleep.

name: Obesity
description: A condition involving excessive body fat that increases health risks.

name: Peptic Ulcer Disease
description: Sores that develop on the lining of the stomach or small intestine.

name: Kidney Stones
symptoms: Severe flank pain;Blood in urine;Nausea;Frequent urination
description: Hard deposits of minerals and salts in kidneys.

name: Chronic Kidney Disease
symptoms: Fatigue;Swelling of feet;Frequent urination;Loss of appetite
description: Gradual loss of kidney function over time.

name: Liver Cirrhosis
description: Chronic liver damage leading to scarring.

name: Heart Failure
symptoms: Shortness of breath;Swelling in legs;Fatigue;Rapid heartbeat
description: A condition where the heart cannot pump blood efficiently.

name: Coronary Artery Disease
description: Narrowing or blockage of coronary arteries.

name: Stroke
description: Interruption of blood supply to the brain.

name: Multiple Sclerosis
description: A disease where immune system attacks nerve coverings.

name: Lupus
description: An autoimmune disease affecting multiple organs.

name: Celiac Disease
description: An immune reaction to eating gluten.

name: Vertigo
description: A sensation of spinning or dizziness.

name: Hemorrhoids
description: Swollen veins in lower rectum or anus.

name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
description: A common disorder affecting the large intestine.

name: Crohn’s Disease
description: An inflammatory bowel disease affecting digestive tract.

name: Glaucoma
description: A group of eye conditions damaging optic nerve.

name: Otitis Externa
description: Inflammation of the outer ear canal.

name: Vitamin D Deficiency
description: Low levels of vitamin D in the body.

name: Vitamin B12 Deficiency
description: Lack of vitamin B12 affecting nerves and blood.

name: Scabies
description: A contagious skin infestation caused by mites.

name: Athlete’s Foot
description: A fungal infection of the feet.

name: Iron Deficiency Anemia
description: Low iron levels leading to reduced red blood cells.

name: Sickle Cell Disease
symptoms: Pain episodes;Fatigue;Swelling of hands and feet
description: A genetic blood disorder affecting hemoglobin.

name: Thalassemia
description: An inherited blood disorder affecting hemoglobin.

name: Deep Vein Thrombosis
description: Formation of blood clot in deep veins.

name: Varicose Veins
description: Enlarged twisted veins usually in legs.

name: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
description: A disorder characterized by extreme tiredness.

name: Motion Sickness
description: A disturbance of balance caused by motion.

name: Seasonal Affective Disorder
description: A type of depression related to seasonal changes.

name: Obsessive Compulsive Disorder
description: A mental disorder with unwanted recurring thoughts.

name: Bipolar Disorder
description: A mental health condition causing extreme mood changes.

name: Schizophrenia
description: A chronic brain disorder affecting perception.

name: Autism Spectrum Disorder
description: A developmental disorder affecting behavior and communication.

name: Dyslexia
description: A learning disorder affecting reading ability.

name: Cerebral Palsy
description: A disorder affecting movement and posture.

name: Muscular Dystrophy
description: A genetic disorder causing muscle degeneration.

name: Trigeminal Neuralgia
description: A chronic pain condition affecting facial nerves.

name: Herniated Disc
description: A disc problem in the spine.

name: Scoliosis
description: Abnormal sideways curvature of the spine.

name: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
description: Compression of median nerve in wrist.

name: Sunburn
description: Skin damage due to UV rays.

name: Pressure Ulcers
description: Injury to skin due to pressure.

name: Shift Work Sleep Disorder
description: Sleep disorder due to work schedule.

name: Decompression Sickness
description: Formation of gas bubbles in blood.
